% trimclip loaded with pdfTeX's driver option before graphicx, which it
% passes the option to as it loads graphicx; then graphicx loaded again
% with the option, which is no clash. The clipped text and the picture are
% as without the option, where trimclip uses its dvips driver.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage[pdftex]{trimclip}
\usepackage[pdftex]{graphicx}
\begin{document}
Clip: \clipbox{1pt 0pt 1pt 0pt}{clipped text}. After the clip.

Picture: \includegraphics[width=1cm]{test-picture.png}. After the picture.
\end{document}
